name: Semantic Infeasibility Framing
description: Replaces the explicit structural definition (three mutually connected nodes) with its semantic consequence (a subset of three items that cannot be validly partitioned into two sets). This forces the model to logically deduce the Pigeonhole Principle mapping (3 items in 2 bins requires all 3 pairs to be constrained to guarantee a collision) before it can recognize the problem as triangle finding.
